column3: At any rate. Do you get it, Kirino? There's no brother who'd be happy about going out with his little sister.
Right, right. So I'll have to be the one that insists. Geez, you're so dishonest with yourself.
Oh geez. Fine. So, are we done?
Then let's go home. This is just bad for my heart.
Huh? There's still places we have to go, of course!
Yup! Grab those bags and let's go!
